svg.title: An empty page still needs to advance past hidden candidates
svg.desc: After p5 was returned, the cursor is at index1 in p5 p4 p3 p2 p1. Author A makes p4 author-only and B deletes p3. A scan budget of two consumes both, returns no items and emits a cursor at index3. Unfollowing A then makes p2 and p1 ineligible. Scanning them advances to index5 and null continuation. No hidden body is returned; empty items alone does not mean exhaustion.
svg.text: Advance by candidates examined, including those rejected
Session: [p5, p4, p3, p2, p1] · page size 1 · maximum 2 candidates scanned/request.
p5 already returned → current candidate index 1
items = [] · scanned = 2 · next index = 3 · continuation exists
A last-returned-item cursor could not move here. A scan-position cursor can.
Then V unfollows A: p2 and p1 are also skipped.
The next request reaches index 5; items = []; nextCursor = null.
Null continuation marks exhaustion. Permission comes from current authority, not a cached ID.
